title: PriceProposal
description: Published by the pricing agent to retail/proposal/{product_id}. QoS 1, NOT retained — a stale proposal reasoning about last week's market is worse than no proposal. This is a RECOMMENDATION, not a decision: the agent never publishes to retail/price. The dashboard evaluates each proposal against the product's policy and either auto-applies it or queues it for a human. Nothing reaches the shelf without passing through that gate.

proposed_price.description: What the agent recommends. Not live until approved.

current_price.description: The approved price currently on the shelf, as the agent understood it when deciding. Lets the dashboard render the delta and evaluate the auto-approve threshold without a second lookup.

decision_id.description: Join key. The matching ExplainVector carries the same decision_id, and it survives onto the published price if the proposal is approved.

reason_tag.description: Human-readable headline reason. Renders verbatim on LCD line 2 of a 16x2 display IF this proposal is approved, so the 16 character limit is a hardware constraint.

agent_version.description: Which policy produced the recommendation, e.g. 'stub-0.1' or 'dqn-2026-10-03'. Required so approval rates can be attributed per agent version — that ratio is an evaluation result.

expires_at.description: After this instant an undecided proposal lapses and the shelf keeps its approved price. Required, not optional: an agent that cannot say how long its reasoning holds has not finished reasoning.
